title: Chalice SMP Modpack
description: The Chalice SMP Modpack is a vanilla+ Fabric modpack designed for SMP play, expanding Minecraft’s world, structures, and exploration while keeping core gameplay familiar.
body:
The Chalice SMP Modpack is a vanilla+ Fabric modpack designed for SMP play, expanding Minecraft’s world, structures, and exploration while keeping core gameplay familiar.

It introduces new biomes, blocks, and reworked structures to make the world feel more detailed, immersive, and rewarding to explore without adding complex progression systems, tech trees, or RPG mechanics.

### Key Features
## Expanded World Generation
- Biomes O’ Plenty adds many new biomes across the Overworld
- New trees, foliage, terrain types, and building blocks
- Greater environmental variety without changing survival balance

## Structure & Dungeon Overhauls
- Several vanilla structures are visually and structurally reworked, including:
- Temples and shrines
- Dungeons and trial structures
- Strongholds
- Select villages and settlements

## These overhauls:
- Make exploration more interesting and less repetitive
- Add variety without changing vanilla progression paths

## Exploration & Adventure Enhancements
- More points of interest while traveling
- Better rewards for exploration
- Encourages wandering, mapping, and discovery

### Performance & Optimization
### 
- Improved FPS and smoother gameplay
- Reduced stuttering and lag spikes
- Better chunk loading during exploration
- Optimized for long multiplayer sessions
- Quality-of-Life Improvements
- Small UI and usability improvements
- QoL features that reduce friction without altering gameplay

## Multiplayer & SMP Focus
- Balanced for shared servers
- No mods that give unfair advantages
- Stable for 24/7 uptime
- Designed around cooperative and social play
